### Instrument Configuration Summary

   - Pinhole 1: Circular aperture, radius $5\text{ mm}$ ($0.005\text{ m}$), placed $3.0\text{ m}$ downstream of the source.

3. **Sample (`Sans_spheres`)**:
   - Positioned $0.2\text{ m}$ downstream of Pinhole 2 ($6.2\text{ m}$ total z-position).
   - Hard sphere radius $R = 100\text{ \AA}$, volume fraction $\Phi = 0.001$ ($0.1\%$).
   - Excess scattering length density $\Delta\rho = 0.6\text{ fm/\AA}^3$.
   - Absorption cross-section $\sigma_{\text{abs}} = 0.5\text{ barns}$.
   - Size: $1\text{ cm} \times 1\text{ cm}$ cross-section ($0.01\text{ m} \times 0.01\text{ m}$), thickness $0.5\text{ cm}$ ($0.005\text{ m}$).
4. **Beamstop (`Beamstop`)**:
   - Circular, radius $2\text{ cm}$ ($0.02\text{ m}$), positioned $2.9\text{ m}$ behind the sample.
5. **Main Detector (`PSD_monitor`)**:
   - Positioned $3.0\text{ m}$ behind the sample.
   - Acceptance: $60\text{ cm} \times 60\text{ cm}$ (i.e. $x, y \in [-0.3, 0.3]\text{ m}$).
   - Resolution: $128 \times 128$ pixels.
6. **Wavelength Monitor (`L_monitor`)**:
   - Positioned just behind the detector plane ($3.001\text{ m}$ behind sample).
